jobs.title: Competentiemanager Engineering
jobs.description:
Den Haag* 
* Universitair oude stijl, Hbo bachelor
* 32 \- 36 uur
* Schaal 12, Schaal 13 / €4\.818 \- €7\.956 (bruto)
* Internationaal, Documentatie en Informatievoorziening, ICT, Juridisch, Techniek / productie, Onderwijs / opleiding, Personeel en organisatie

  
Solliciteer voor 18 oktober 2026
  
**Dit ga je doen**
------------------


Veilig vooruit in een digitaal weerbaar Nederland — dat is waar we bij het NCSC elke dag voor gaan. Als het centrale expertisecentrum en informatieknooppunt voor cybersecurity speelt het NCSC een cruciale rol in het beschermen van de Nederlandse digitale infrastructuur.


Bij het NCSC werk jij in het hart van de Nederlandse cybersecurity. Samen met gedreven collega’s verbind jij publieke en private partners, duik jij diep in de techniek of beleidsvorming, en maak jij direct impact op de digitale veiligheid van miljoenen mensen. Wil jij bijdragen aan een veilig digitaal landschap en meegroeien in een dynamische, maatschappelijke organisatie?


Als competentiemanager ben jij leidinggevende van een groep collega’s, georganiseerd in een competentiecluster, die samen met elkaar werken aan het digitaal weerbaarder maken van Nederland. De directie Digital, Tech en Data (DTD), waarbinnen jij komt te werken, weet data te verwerken tot concrete waarde door informatie slim te analyseren, interpreteren en delen. De directie DTD zorgt er ook voor dat het NCSC met geautomatiseerde processen en dienstverlening snel en effectief waarde kan leveren.


**Wat ga jij doen?**


Binnen het NCSC ben jij als competentiemanager de leidinggevende van een groep medewerkers, voornamelijk bestaande uit full stack developers en designers, georganiseerd in een competentiecluster (25\-40 FTE). Jij staat aan het hoofd van hun thuisbasis in de organisatie, waar jij verantwoordelijk bent voor personeelszorg, vak\-, loopbaan\- en competentieontwikkeling, (strategische) personeelsontwikkeling en zorg jij ervoor dat medewerkers goed op hun plek zitten in de verschillende resultaatteams. Om dit te bereiken sta jij continu in contact met de rest van het management om de optimale samenstelling van de resultaatteams vorm te geven, nu en in de toekomst.


Een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden:


* Jij hebt alle personeelszorg voor de medewerkers in jouw cluster, zoals de personeelscyclus, verzuim, verlof, leren en ontwikkelen. Dit doe jij onder andere door het voeren van reguliere competentiegesprekken;
* Zorgdragen voor het doeltreffend en doelmatig inzetten van medewerkers in de verschillende resultaatteams. Hierbij breng jij de belangen van Waardestromen, teams en de individuele medewerkers op een goede wijze samen;
* Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor de strategische personeelsontwikkeling binnen het vakgebied van jouw competentiecluster. Hierin ben jij goed op de hoogte van wat erop maatschappelijk, technologisch en vakinhoudelijk vlak speelt t.a.v. het vakgebied/vakgebieden van jouw cluster en stem jij voortdurend met verschillende disciplines in de organisatie af.

  
**Dit krijg je**
----------------


* Schaal 12, Schaal 13
  

€4\.818 \- €7\.956 (bruto)
* Arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op onbepaalde tijd
* 12 maanden
* 32 \- 36 uur
* Het salaris is gebaseerd op een werkweek van 36 uur.

  
**Dit bieden we nog meer**
--------------------------


Naast het salaris ontvang je een individueel keuzebudget (IKB). Het IKB bestaat uit geld (16,5% van je bruto jaarsalaris) en tijd. Met het IKB maak jij de keuzes die bij jou passen en kun je een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen. Je kunt er bijvoorbeeld voor kiezen om een deel van je maandinkomen te laten uitbetalen wanneer jij dat wenst. Ook kun je dit budget omzetten in verlof en andersom of besteden aan fiscaalvriendelijke doelen. De Rijksoverheid hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden. Tot de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden behoren onder meer verschillende studiefaciliteiten, bedrijfsfitness, volledige vergoeding van je ov\-reiskosten woon\-werkverkeer en gedeeltelijk betaald ouderschapsverlof.


  
**Dit vragen wij**
------------------


Als competentiemanager ben jij de verbindende schakel tussen organisatieontwikkeling en de groei van medewerkers. Jij bent een strategische en coachende professional die zorgt dat kennis, vaardigheden en talenten optimaal worden benut om de organisatiedoelen te behalen. Met jouw visie, mensgerichte aanpak en daadkracht zorg jij ervoor dat de organisatie klaar is voor de uitdagingen van morgen. Naast deze competenties beschik jij over:


* Hbo/wo\-werk\- en \-denkniveau;
* Ruime aantoonbare leidinggevende ervaring binnen een context van ICT\-professionals, in het domein softwareontwikkeling;
* Actief participeren met het ontwikkelen van strategische personeelsplanning en de doorontwikkeling naar de praktijk;
* Vakmanschap binnen je team aanjagen door samen te leren en gezamenlijk verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor teamresultaten;
* Ervaring in het op strategisch niveau schakelen tussen verschillende belangen en hierbij met de noodzakelijke bestuurlijke sensitiviteit en integrale blik keuzes kunnen maken.

  
**Hier kom je te werken**
-------------------------


### **Over Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum**


Het NCSC werkt aan een digitaal veilig Nederland. Door het tempo waarin het cybersecuritydomein zich ontwikkelt en de rol van het NCSC daarin, ligt er een flinke uitdaging voor de toekomst. Het is voor ons als hét kennisinstituut van cybersecurity in Nederland essentieel dat wij Nederland van kwalitatief hoogwaardige en actuele informatie voorzien, in crisistijd en daarbuiten. Deze kennis en kunde halen wij mede uit en delen wij ook weer met ons netwerk (overheden, bedrijfsleven en andere nationale en internationale partners). Op deze wijze proberen we tijdig in te springen op nieuw ontdekte kwetsbaarheden, aanvalscampagnes en ernstige ICT\-verstoringen om deze te voorkomen en op te lossen. Als het toch misgaat beperken we op deze manier de impact.


  
**Bijzonderheden**
------------------


Het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum (NCSC) is een groeiende organisatie in transitie met uiteenlopende vraagstukken waarbij flexibiliteit gewenst is om ook in de toekomst wendbaar te blijven tegen cyberdreigingen. Interesse? Graag ontvangen wij jouw cv en motivatie als word\- of pdf\-bestand via onderstaande sollicitatiebutton. Werken bij een crisisorganisatie vraagt om flexibiliteit van onze medewerkers. Via een piket\- en\-of bereikbaarheid dienst (bepaalde functie) kan er in het geval van acute dreigingen en incidenten, ook buiten kantooruren een beroep op je worden gedaan. Als we goede sollicitaties binnenkrijgen kan het zijn dat we de sluitingstermijn niet afwachten. Heb je interesse, reageer dan snel!

  

Wat mag je van ons verwachten? Wanneer we een match zien nemen we contact met je op om een eerste sollicitatiegesprek in te plannen. De sollicitatieprocedure bestaat uit twee sollicitatiegesprekken gevolgd door een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek. Een casus, opdracht, assessment en/of vaardigheidstest kan deel uitmaken van het sollicitatieproces, net als het opvragen van referenties en het inzetten van een (online) screening.

  

Het toetsen van de integriteit van onze nieuwe collega’s is voor het Nationaal Cyber Security Centrum van groot belang. Om die reden maakt een veiligheidsonderzoek op niveau A of B deel uit van het sollicitatieproces. Dit onderzoek wordt uitgevoerd door de Algemene Inlichtingen\- en Veiligheidsdienst en neemt doorgaans acht weken in beslag. Meer informatie over het onderzoek vind je op https://www.aivd.nl/onderwerpen/veiligheidsonderzoek. Jouw werklocatie zal thuis en op kantoor zijn. Meer informatie hierover kun je terugvinden op CAO Rijk.


  
**Over de functiegroep Manager**
--------------------------------


Door het Functiegebouw Rijk worden medewerkers en leidinggevenden geholpen bij het maken van resultaat\- en ontwikkelafspraken in functioneringsgesprekken en krijgt men inzicht in de loopbaanmogelijkheden binnen de Rijksoverheid.

jobs.title: Senior Industrial Engineer – Enschede
jobs.description:
**Introductie**
---------------


Wil jij werken aan vraagstukken die direct invloed hebben op hoe fabrieken produceren, bewegen en groeien? Als senior Industrial Engineer bij Ergo\-Design in Enschede werk je aan uiteenlopende projecten binnen de proces\- en maakindustrie.


Van het ontwerpen van een compleet nieuwe fabriekslay\-out tot het optimaliseren van logistieke stromen, assemblageprocessen en productielijnen. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om projecten zelfstandig én samen met collega's tot een goed resultaat te brengen.


Je komt in dienst bij Ergo\-Design Industrial Engineering in Enschede. Ergo\-Design is gelieerd aan de AKOS Groep; beide organisaties worden geleid door Ferry en Reinier.


**Functie**
-----------


De projecten verschillen sterk in omvang en inhoud. Zo kun je betrokken zijn bij het herinrichten van een bestaande productielocatie of juist vanaf de basis meedenken over de inrichting van een nieuwe fabriek. Afhankelijk van het project houd je je bezig met:


* Analyseren, ontwerpen en optimaliseren van logistieke, fabricage\- en assemblageprocessen.
* Ontwerpen en optimaliseren van fabrieks\- en magazijnlay\-outs.
* Opstellen van masterplannen voor productieomgevingen.
* Ontwikkelen van logistieke concepten en productielijnen.
* Adviseren van klanten over productie\-, logistieke en lay\-outvraagstukken.
* Laten uitvoeren en interpreteren van logistieke simulaties.
* Presenteren en onderbouwen van ontwerpen en verbetervoorstellen.
* Begeleiden van junior engineers.
* Inhoudelijk leiden en coördineren van projecten.

Net zoals bij AKOS kijk je regelmatig letterlijk en figuurlijk in de keuken bij verschillende industriële bedrijven. Met jouw ervaring vertaal je complexe productie\- en logistieke vraagstukken naar praktische, toekomstbestendige oplossingen.


**Aanbod**
----------


Als senior Industrial Engineer bij Ergo\-Design heb je veel ruimte om je eigen expertise in te zetten en verder uit te bouwen. Je krijgt het vertrouwen om je projecten en werkzaamheden zelfstandig vorm te geven, met collega’s om op terug te vallen wanneer dat nodig is. Daar staan goede voorwaarden tegenover:


**✓** Afwisselende projecten bij (middel)grote industriële bedrijven, waardoor je als Engineer kennismaakt met verschillende organisaties, productieomgevingen en technische uitdagingen.
  

**✓** Bruto maandsalaris tussen €5\.200,00 en €7\.200,00, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.
  

**✓** Winstdeling, pensioentoeslag en reis\- en onkostenvergoeding.
  

**✓** Keuze uit een dienstverband van 0,8 tot 1,0 FTE, met uitzicht op een vast contract.
  

**✓** Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om deels vanuit huis te werken.
  

**✓** 25 vakantiedagen bij een 38\-urige werkweek (1 FTE). Werk je liever structureel 40 uur? Dan bouw je 11 extra vrije dagen op.
  

**✓** Informeel en betrokken team dat ook buiten het werk graag samen iets onderneemt.


**En meer. Klinkt dit als een werkomgeving die bij je past? Solliciteer direct of neem contact met Menno om eens kennis te maken:** **m.hoeksema@ergodesign.nl** **of \+31 53 4800 556\.**


**Functie eisen**
-----------------


Voor deze seniorfunctie zoeken we een ervaren Industrial Engineer met een achtergrond in Werktuigbouwkunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde of Logistiek op hbo\- of wo\-niveau. Daarnaast:


**✓** Vertrouwd met methoden en technieken binnen Lean Production.
  

**✓** Ruime ervaring met productie\- en logistieke processen binnen een industriële omgeving.
  

**✓** Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.


Ervaring met SLP is een pré, maar geen vereiste als je dit wil leren. Ervaring met CAD is eveneens mooi meegenomen.


**Organisatie**
---------------


Ergo\-Design Industrial Engineering BV ondersteunt al meer dan 35 jaar de proces\- en maakindustrie in binnen\- en buitenland. Vanuit Enschede helpt Ergo\-Design bedrijven met het professionaliseren en toekomstbestendig maken van hun productie\- en logistieke processen.


De Engineers van Ergo\-Design stellen masterplannen op en ontwerpen en optimaliseren fabriekslay\-outs, logistieke concepten en productielijnen. Daarbij zetten we onder andere logistieke simulaties, 3D\-scanning en ergonomische expertise in. Ook voert Ergo\-Design logistieke simulaties uit, worden fabrieken in 3D gescand en worden voorgestelde verbeteringen op de werkvloer geïmplementeerd.

jobs.title: Middle .NET Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced **Software Engineer** to join a dedicated team working on high\-impact, enterprise\-scale software solutions for public sector funding and financial management systems.



The candidate will work within a large\-scale ecosystem comprising core transactional systems, reporting tools, and public application portals. You will play a key role in developing new features, integrating modern microservices, refactoring legacy components, and migrating services to modern technologies (.NET 6/8, modern web frameworks).


### **Key Responsibilities**


* **Systems Analysis \& Architecture:** Analyze requirements, extract business logic from legacy systems, and create modeling/visualization artifacts using UML standards.
* **Full\-Stack Development:** Design, maintain, and expand back\-end services and front\-end portals using C\#/.NET, REST APIs, and modern UI tools.
* **Legacy Refactoring \& Decoupling:** Write anti\-corruption layers and seams to safely isolate legacy code from new, modern application components.
* **Data Access \& Databases:** Design and optimize database access structures using MSSQL, Entity Framework Core (Code\-First), and the repository pattern.
* **Testing \& Quality Assurance:** Create decoupled unit tests, write feature documentation, and conduct end\-to\-end (E2E) testing on newly built features.
* **Agile Collaboration:** Participate in daily stand\-ups and Agile/Scrum ceremonies, managing code, documentation, and tasks via Azure DevOps.

### **Requirements**


**Education \& Experience:**


* **Bachelor's Degree** in IT, Computer Science, or a related field (MQF Level 6 or equivalent).
* **3\+ years of professional experience** in software development and systems analysis.
* Practical experience working in Agile/Scrum environments using tools like Azure DevOps.


**Technical Skills:**


* **Back\-End \& Frameworks:** Strong proficiency in C\#, .NET Framework 4\.8, .NET 6/8, ASP.NET MVC, REST APIs, and Entity Framework Core.
* **Front\-End Development:** Experience with HTML5, CSS, Bootstrap, AJAX, JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, OpenXML, and modern web frameworks (Angular, React, or Blazor).
* **Databases:** Strong knowledge and practical experience with MSSQL, Entity Framework (Code\-First), and repository patterns.
* **Architecture \& Clean Code:** Solid understanding of Object\-Oriented Design (OOD), writing decoupled unit tests, and designing anti\-corruption layers.
* **Version Control \& DevTools:** Hands\-on experience with Git/Azure Repositories and Browser Development Tools (DevTools).

**We offer\*:**


* Flexible working format \- remote, office\-based or flexible
* A competitive salary and good compensation package
* Personalized career growth
* Professional development tools (mentorship program, tech talks and trainings, centers of excellence, and more)
* Active tech communities with regular knowledge sharing
* Education reimbursement
* Memorable anniversary presents
* Corporate events and team buildings
* Other location\-specific benefits


* not applicable for freelancers

jobs.title: Backend Developer (Django)
jobs.description:
At DeWarmte, we make smart, affordable heat pumps that help homes move away from gas. We design the hardware, software and services ourselves, so the quality of our software directly shapes how well our products work in people's homes.

We're growing fast. More customers, more connected heat pumps and more products relying on our backend mean the platform needs to grow with us. That's why we're looking for a Backend Developer to build and improve the Django platform behind our web application, customer app and employee app. It connects these products with our heat pumps, data platform and external partners.

You'll spend most of your time writing code: improving reliability and performance, building new functionality and helping the platform scale with our customer base and installed fleet.

AI tools are already part of how we build software. We use them where they help us move faster, but we do not lower the bar: anything we ship still needs to be secure, maintainable and correct. You'll help us get better at both.

Why this role matters

Build the connected intelligence behind DeWarmte—linking our heat pumps, digital products, internal systems and smart-home partners to make every installation smarter, more efficient and easier to use.

You'll join the team behind backend systems that already support customers and heat pumps in the field. You'll get to know them deeply, keep them reliable and evolve their architecture as DeWarmte grows. Just as important: you'll help make sure knowledge and operational ownership are shared across the team.

What you'll do

Develop and improve our Django backend

Work directly in the production Python/Django code behind our web application, customer app and employee app.
Design, build, test and deploy new APIs, services and business logic, covering everything from the customer journey and planning to heat pump control and service.
Improve performance, stability, security and data integrity.
Diagnose and fix issues that span our backend, data platform and devices in the field.

Connect and scale the platform

Make sure our backend, databases and background processing keep up with a fast-growing customer base and installed fleet.
Connect our backend with our heat pumps, data platform, web application, mobile apps, internal tools and smart-home platforms such as Homey, Home Assistant and HomeWizard.
Define clear, well-documented interfaces between device software, cloud services and the products that depend on them.
Put the right automated testing, observability, monitoring and release practices in place.

Build with AI

Use AI tools to support design, coding, testing, reviews and documentation.
Help the team improve its AI workflows, shared context and quality checks.
Try new tools, keep what works and share what you learn.
Hold AI-assisted code to the same standards as any other production code.

Share ownership

Turn implicit knowledge into clear documentation, tooling and repeatable engineering practices.
Design systems that other engineers can easily understand, test and safely change.
Take part in code reviews and technical decision-making.
Help onboard and support fellow engineers.

Work across the company

This role reaches across the product. You'll work with colleagues in web, apps, hardware, controls, data, product development, installation and service to solve today's issues without compromising the platform for tomorrow.

What success looks like

In your first few months

You understand the existing backend, its data flows and its operational risks.
You can independently maintain, debug and release backend changes through the team's review and release practices.
The most important technical risks and knowledge gaps are visible and prioritised.
Monitoring, documentation and development practices are visibly improving.

As the role develops

New backend functionality ships predictably and safely.
The platform scales smoothly as our fleet and customer base grow.
Incidents are detected early and resolved in a structured way.
The team uses AI tools confidently and responsibly in its day-to-day work.
Critical backend systems are understood and maintained by more than one person.

Who we're looking for

Solid hands-on backend engineering experience, including ownership of production systems.
Deep Python and Django expertise, including the Django ORM and REST APIs (e.g. Django REST Framework).
Strong knowledge of relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL): data modelling, query optimisation and migrations.
Experience with background processing, queues or event streaming, and with integrating external systems.
A track record of taking functionality from design through implementation, testing and deployment to real-world operation.
Strong engineering fundamentals: version control, automated testing, CI/CD, observability and structured incident handling.
You use AI coding tools in practice and understand both their value and their limits.
The ability to bring clarity to an environment where systems and processes are still taking shape.

Experience with IoT, connected devices, telemetry, time-series data such as Kafka or InfluxDB, or cloud infrastructure is useful, but not essential. What matters most is that you can learn a complex physical product and take responsibility from code to production.

How you work

You fix urgent problems without letting short-term workarounds become long-term architecture.
You explain complex technical topics clearly to people from any background.
You balance reliability today with the investments needed to scale tomorrow.
You're curious about new AI tools, try them quickly and share what works.
You're comfortable switching between debugging a production issue, reviewing architecture and helping a teammate.
You share knowledge by default and care about what the team can own together.

What we offer

A role with direct impact on the backend systems at the heart of a real physical product and the energy transition.
The chance to shape a fast-growing platform and how we build it.
Room to improve how we use AI tools across the software team.
A gross monthly salary of €5,000 – €6,500, based on full-time employment.
27 vacation days and 8% holiday allowance.
The chance to share in DeWarmte's growth through our Stock Appreciation Rights (SAR) programme.
An ambitious, collaborative team and real responsibility from day one.
Daily lunch at the office.
A laptop, access to the AI tools we use and everything else you need to do your best work.
Regular team activities, including our annual Beach Day and Winter Trip.
Plenty of room to grow, develop yourself and make a lasting impact.

jobs.title: Liferay Engineer
jobs.description:
Telespazio Belgium can count on more than 45 years of experience in the field of Space Operations Service & Engineering activities.

Come and build innovative services that protect our cloud from advanced security threats!

As a Software Development Engineer on our team, you’ll help build and manage services that detect and automate the mitigation of cybersecurity threats across Amazon’s infrastructure, including advanced persistent threats. You’ll work with security engineers, data scientists, and other software development engineers across multiple teams to develop innovative security solutions at a massive scale. Our services protect the AWS cloud for all customers and help preserve our customers’ trust in us. You’ll get to use the full power and breadth of AWS technologies to build services that proactively protect every single AWS customer, both internally and externally, from security threats – not many teams can say that!

We’re looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers. We want someone who will help us amplify the positive and inclusive team culture we’ve been building.

Key job responsibilities

As a Software Development Engineer, you will leverage Amazon technology (Lambda, Kinesis, DynamoDB, etc.) to solve AWS Security problems at staggering scale. You will raise the bar on our software architecture and development practices. You will share ownership of our operational excellence, ensuring our system is properly tuned and has appropriate alarms for warning or error conditions. You will help drive our working backwards processes, inventing and simplifying on behalf of our customers. You will build security detections that identify specific security issues and automatically help customers reduce their risk through network and security controls.

On-Call Responsibility

This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. You will also have specific on-call responsibilities to support the European Sovereign Cloud. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.

Collaborate with data scientists and security engineers to build automated security detection and mitigation workflows
Design scalable architectures for low-latency, big data processing
Improve the observability, performance, and efficiency of our existing systems
Raise the bar for testing, repeatability, automation, and operational excellence
Mentor and develop teammates, both technically and professionally
Seek out, develop, and advocate for new technologies

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

. PANDORA’s Digital & Technology Hub in Warsaw
is a key part of the world’s largest jewellery brand, supporting millions of people in expressing their emotions through meaningful jewellery. As one of our fast-growing global locations, the Warsaw Hub plays a vital role in driving digital innovation, delivering scalable technology solutions and supporting our global transformation journey. Our teams work closely with colleagues across the globe, including our headquarters in Copenhagen, to shape the future of digital in retail and e-commerce.
Behind every great experience at Pandora is a robust digital foundation. Our engineering teams build and connect the systems that power our global ecosystem. You will join a dynamic environment where innovation meets reliability, and every integration is crafted with care. We value creative problem-solving, collaboration, and continuous improvement—ensuring equitable opportunities for all.
We’re proud of our inclusive, people-first culture, guided by our values: We Care, We Dream, We Dare, We Deliver.

Role Summary:

The Engineer is a delivering member of a GOPT (Omni Operations Product Line) product team. You will build and support the integration solutions that keep Pandora's supply chain and distribution systems running, working within the technical direction set by your Lead Engineer and inside the agreed architecture and engineering standards. You will need good communication skills to work with your team, product colleagues and business analysts.
You will help deliver quality automated CI/CD pipelines, from requirements through test and behaviour driven development, whilst maintaining operational stability and high coding standards, together with supporting quality deployments, monitoring of the tech stack and overall production health.
The main outcome for this role is dependable delivery — well-tested, well-documented code shipped with minimal disruption to the business — and steady growth towards owning larger pieces of work independently. You will be part of our engineering chapter and will contribute to a DevSecOps culture towards build and run.

Key accountabilities System design and architecture Contribute to the design of integration solutions using .NET technologies and event-driven architecture, working to the technical approach set by the Lead Engineer and within the agreed architecture blueprint
Work with cross-functional colleagues (product management, architects, business analysts) to understand business requirements and translate them into technical tasks
Raise design questions, risks and unknowns early rather than resolving them alone

Integration development Develop and implement .NET-based integration components under the technical direction of a Senior or Lead Engineer, ensuring correct data flow across platforms, systems and applications
Write automated, reusable, testable and efficient code, applying Pandora engineering standards for performance, security and scalability
Participate actively in pair programming and code review — both submitting your work and reviewing the work of peers
Write and maintain unit and integration tests within the team's automated testing frameworks
Maintain technical documentation for the components you build — integration mappings, API specifications and troubleshooting notes
Identify opportunities to simplify or improve existing integrations and propose them to the team

Deployment and operations support Prepare and execute deployments of your changes into non-production environments, and support production deployments alongside a more senior engineer
Provide post-deployment support and monitoring; join the on-duty engineering roster once onboarded, with a defined escalation path to Senior and Lead Engineers

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Cloud & Data)
jobs.description:
Humblebee is a digital service studio in Sweden. We build digital products with ambitious companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with a cloud and data profile to join our product teams, where business, design and tech sit at the same table.

Why this role exists

Software engineering has changed. AI went from a feature you bolt on to a material you build with. That means knowing what to build, getting the data in order, and making the thing survive contact with production and real users.
We’re looking for breadth, and for someone who doesn’t need to be led. You see what needs doing, you say it out loud, and you get it done.

What you’ll be doing

You might be the spearhead: one engineer covering everything a client needs. You might work in a duo with a service designer, where the two of you cover each other’s blind spots. You might sit in a multidisciplinary team with engineers, designers and business-minded colleagues, sometimes ours, sometimes the client’s.

The mix shifts with the assignment. The work could include:

Sitting with clients to understand their business, then turning that into something you can build and ship.
Mapping how work actually gets done, and finding where AI saves real hours instead of looking clever.
Setting up complete AI flows, from data source through model and tooling to the interface people use, and the numbers that prove it pays off.
Building web and product features end to end, from data model to interface.
Designing data flows: getting data out of the systems it’s stuck in, cleaning it, and making it useful.
Building and running AI features that people rely on, such as retrieval, search, agents, recommendations and automated workflows, with evaluation and guardrails in place.
Working with cloud platforms and infrastructure as code so what we build can be deployed, monitored and handed over.
Taking prototypes to production, and being honest about which ones shouldn’t get there.
Using AI tools in your own work, and helping the rest of us get better at it.
Explaining trade-offs, assumptions and limits to people who don’t write code.

Is this you?

You’re a strong engineer first. You’re curious about how a business makes money, not just about the stack. You’d rather ship a small thing that works than a big thing that demos well. AI helps you move fast, and you still own what comes out: it has to hold up a year from now, for whoever picks it up next.

You likely have:

8+ years building and running software in production, ideally client-facing.
Solid experience with cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS, and with infrastructure as code.
Practical experience with data: pipelines, warehouses and lakehouses. Microsoft Fabric, Databricks or similar is a plus.
Strong TypeScript, C#, Java or Python. We work mostly in the JavaScript/TypeScript stack, with .NET, C# and Java in some teams, and Python where it fits.
Hands-on experience putting AI into real products: LLM APIs, retrieval, tooling and agents, plus how you know whether it works.
A feel for CI/CD, observability and security, because someone has to run this after we hand it over.
Comfort in the room with clients, including the ones who don’t know what they want yet.
The ability to say no, kindly, when a client asks for the wrong thing.

We like T-shaped people: deep in something, useful across the whole. Nobody knows everything, and we don’t expect you to. We do expect you to feel responsible for the whole, and to be straight about where your edges are.

You are as important as your skills

We hire people as much for their human traits as for their skills. We like good humans around us. We work in the open, in design sprints, development sprints and workshops with clients, so we hire people who are empathetic, kind, patient and generous. We are Humblebee.

Before you apply, read this carefully

To help us find the right fit, we prioritise candidates on these criteria:
Engineering craft.
 You build software that’s secure, fast and still holds up a year later, and you can point to it.
Data and cloud.
 Real experience moving data around and running things in the cloud, not just reading about it.
Business translation.
 You can turn a vague business problem into a clear technical plan, and explain it back in plain language.
Finding the work.
 You spot the inefficiency the client has stopped noticing, and you can size the value of fixing it.
AI in practice.
 You’ve shipped AI features and can tell us what broke, what you measured and what you’d do differently.
Collaboration.
 You like multidisciplinary teams and you make the people around you better.
Growth mindset.
 You share what you learn and help improve how we work.

Tell us about concrete projects. What was the business problem, what did you build, what changed as a result. Outcomes beat tech lists.

Good to know

This position is full-time, based in our Gothenburg office with a hybrid working model (part office, part home). A Swedish work permit is required. We don’t offer relocation assistance or visa sponsorship.
Humblebee is a multi-lingual company, so please write your application in English.

Impact that matters.

AI-first engineering culture.
We build with Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and custom AI skills — AI isn't a buzzword here, it's how we ship.

International exposure working with sponsors and partners across Europe, the US, and beyond.

Build and maintain application components:

Development and implementation of logic within the application components required to deliver approved application functionality and use cases.
Implement application features, scripts, connectors, interfaces and dashboards.

A core objective is to convert manual, fragmented or repetitive activities into secure, observable and reusable automated processes that deliver measurable operational outcomes. The role ensures that AI-enabled applications and automations are not isolated proofs of concept, but supportable production services that integrate reliably with customer processes and systems.
Key Responsibilities

Automation Development & Intelligent Process Orchestration
Maintain automation assets throughout their lifecycle, including versioning, testing, deployment, monitoring, incident resolution and continuous optimisation.
Refactor proofs of concept and low-code workflows into governed, observable and supportable production services when scale, criticality or complexity requires it.
Measure automation outcomes including transaction completion, processing time, failure rate, manual effort avoided, rework and operational cost.
Define exception paths, audit trails, manual recovery procedures and operational controls for business-critical automations.
Combine deterministic workflow logic with AI capabilities such as classification, extraction, summarisation, routing, decision support and agent tool execution.
Automate interactions with Microsoft 365 and enterprise platforms using Microsoft Graph, APIs, webhooks, events, queues and secure workload identities.
Build reusable connectors, custom connectors, workflow templates, automation libraries and common services that reduce delivery time across customer projects.
Implement scheduled, event-triggered, short-running, long-running and human-in-the-loop workflows, including state management, approvals, timeouts, escalation, compensation and recovery logic.
Design, develop, test, deploy and operate end-to-end automations using Azure Functions, AWS Lambda, Logic Apps, Durable Functions, Step Functions, Power Automate and code-based orchestration where appropriate.
Analyse business and operational processes to identify automation opportunities, define automation boundaries and translate requirements into maintainable technical workflows.

Cloud-native Integration & Automation Engineering
Design and implement API-first, event-driven and asynchronous integration solutions using Azure Functions or AWS Lambda, Event Grid or EventBridge, Service Bus or SQS/SNS, and workflow orchestration services such as Logic Apps, Durable Functions or Step Functions.
Build reusable automation components, connectors and integration services using C#, Python, TypeScript or PowerShell, applying appropriate software engineering standards.
Integrate enterprise systems, SaaS platforms, data services and AI endpoints through REST, GraphQL, webhooks, messaging and event streaming patterns.
Modernise legacy point-to-point integrations into loosely coupled, scalable and maintainable cloud-native patterns.
Assess and implement synchronous versus asynchronous patterns, delivery semantics, ordering, idempotency, deduplication, dead-letter handling and eventual consistency.

API Management & Enterprise Integration
Design, publish and govern APIs using Azure API Management and AWS API Gateway, including policies, authentication, authorisation, throttling, quotas, versioning, transformations, caching, lifecycle management and developer onboarding.
Create and maintain API contracts and documentation using OpenAPI specifications, consistent error models and backward-compatible versioning practices.
Integrate with Microsoft 365 services through Microsoft Graph, including appropriate permissions, consent models, webhook subscriptions, change notifications and throttling-aware implementations.
Collaborate with architects to define reusable integration reference architectures, standards and guardrails for customer delivery teams.

Identity, Security & Secrets Management
Implement workload identity and zero-trust patterns using Managed Identities, AWS IAM roles, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, avoiding embedded credentials wherever possible.
Protect credentials, certificates, keys and connection details using Azure Key Vault or AWS Secrets Manager, including secure rotation and access-control practices.
Apply least privilege, managed service-to-service authentication, network controls, encryption and secure API exposure throughout the integration lifecycle.
Contribute to threat modelling, security reviews and remediation of integration components in collaboration with Cyber Security and Cloud teams.

AI-enabled Workflow Integration
Integrate Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents and other model endpoints into enterprise workflows and applications.
Engineer the deterministic components around AI systems, including input validation, context retrieval, tool and function calling, business-rule enforcement, human approval, output handling and fallback paths.
Implement resilient orchestration for long-running or multi-step AI processes, with appropriate state management, timeout handling, compensation and human-in-the-loop controls.
Ensure sensitive data, prompts, model outputs and integration telemetry are handled in accordance with security, privacy and responsible AI requirements.

Observability, Reliability & Operational Excellence
Instrument integrations end to end using Application Insights, Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch and OpenTelemetry.
Implement distributed tracing, transaction correlation, correlation IDs, structured logging, metrics and actionable alerts across APIs, functions, queues, events and AI dependencies.
Design robust error-handling and resilience mechanisms, including retries with backoff and jitter, timeouts, circuit breakers, bulkheads, poison-message handling, dead-letter queues and replay procedures.
Define service-level indicators and operational dashboards covering availability, latency, throughput, error rate, queue depth, dependency health, cost and business transaction completion.
Perform production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis across distributed systems, and produce runbooks that enable effective support and incident response.

Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD & Quality Engineering
Provision and configure integration services using Terraform and Bicep, with modular, reusable and environment-aware infrastructure definitions.
Build CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, incorporating code quality, security scanning, automated tests, deployment approvals and rollback strategies.
Implement unit, contract, integration, end-to-end, performance, resilience and failure-mode testing for APIs, workflows and event-driven components.
Use source control, peer review, branching and release-management practices appropriate to enterprise delivery.
Optimise solutions for scalability, reliability, maintainability, performance and cloud cost.

Agile Delivery, Documentation & Continuous Improvement
Work with Product Owners, Architects, Testers, Cloud Developers, AI Engineers and service teams to deliver product increments against agreed sprint goals.
Produce clear technical documentation covering APIs, events, message schemas, data flows, identity, deployment, observability, support and recovery procedures.
Create proofs of concept and technical spikes to validate patterns, while ensuring successful patterns can be hardened for production use.
Mentor colleagues, review technical work and contribute reusable accelerators, standards and lessons learned to the wider AI and application practice.

Required Experience
5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, systems integration, cloud application development or automation, including at least 2 years delivering cloud-native integrations in production.
Demonstrable experience developing end-to-end business process automations, rather than only configuring integration platforms or defining architectures.
Demonstrable hands-on delivery of APIs, serverless components, messaging solutions and event-driven architectures on Azure or AWS.
Experience operating distributed integrations in production, including troubleshooting, performance analysis, resilience engineering and support handover.
Experience working in Agile delivery teams and collaborating with architecture, security, test, data and operations functions.
Fluent Spanish and professional working proficiency in English.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience in an IT services, systems integrator, managed services or consulting environment.
Relevant certifications such as Azure Developer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, AWS Developer or Solutions Architect, and HashiCorp Terraform Associate.
Experience with containers, Kubernetes, Dapr, Kafka or enterprise integration platforms is advantageous.
Experience delivering solutions for regulated or security-sensitive customers is advantageous.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in computer science, software engineering or a related discipline.

Working Conditions & Package
Hybrid working model, with Madrid preferred and flexibility to work from SCC Spain offices as required.
Travel within Spain for customer delivery, workshops and collaboration with SCC teams.

OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world’s critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

The Position

MetaDefender Managed File Transfer (MFT) is the next generation of OPSWAT's file transfer solution — built for scale and security, with OPSWAT's threat prevention technology built into every file flow.

We're looking for a mid-level Sustaining Engineer to join the MFT engineering team and act as the technical bridge between our customers and our developers. Reporting to the MFT Engineering Manager, you'll be the first engineer on customer-escalated bugs and technical questions — diagnosing issues, fixing what you can directly, and routing the rest to the right place. You'll keep the core dev team focused on building the product instead of firefighting every live customer issue.

What You Will Be Doing

Own the triage of customer-escalated bugs and technical questions.
Spot when a reported issue is really an enhancement request, and route it accordingly instead of building a one-off fix.
Join ad hoc customer calls with Customer Experience, Sales, and Solution Engineers to troubleshoot live issues.
Diagnose escalated issues, implement C# fixes, and ship them through standard PR review.
Write and run targeted MSSQL scripts for one-off customer fixes when needed.
Build and maintain a knowledge base for recurring issues.
Develop AI tools to improve escalation handling and troubleshooting.
Participate in weekend on-call support when needed.

What We Need From You

Mid-level experience — comfortable owning a live customer issue independently.
Solid C# skills: enough to read, debug, and safely patch an existing codebase under time pressure.
Comfortable writing and running MSSQL scripts against production-adjacent data.
Working knowledge of infrastructure, enough to reason about where a customer issue lives in the stack.
Strong spoken and written English — you'll be in front of customers regularly.

It Would be Nice if You Had

A stable, growing international company with an established customer base across 50+ countries.
Direct ownership: your fixes reach real customers fast, with no long release queue for the small stuff.
Professional development through training, mentoring, and real opportunities for advancement.
